summary: This survey reframes memory in LLM-based agents around representations, operations, and emerging topics rather than only application-level memory usage.
why_it_matters: It is a high-value survey note because it updates the memory-agent landscape and fills gaps left by earlier memory surveys.
method_setup: The paper surveys memory representations, atomic memory operations, datasets, tools, and emerging research directions for LLM-based agents.
key_claims: Existing memory surveys are too narrow and often omit important operations such as indexing.
A more structured taxonomy is needed to connect memory representations, operations, and agent behavior.
limitations: As a survey, it synthesizes prior work rather than introducing a benchmark or system.
Its scope is broad, so fine-grained implementation guidance is limited.
builds_on_unresolved: A Survey on the Memory Mechanism of Large Language Model based Agents
